newsitem.title: USA: Rymer Foods to restructure 11 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Rymer Foods to restructure 11 pct notes.

text.p: Rymer Foods Inc said Friday it plans to restructure its 11 percent senior notes in an effort to improve its liquidity and capital structure.
Earlier, the company posted a loss of $0.30 a share for the October 26 fourth quarter, compared with a year-earlier loss of $2.41. Sales declined to $11.4 million from $18.4 milion.
Rymer, which supplies portion-controlled steaks and food items to the foodservice market, said its future success depends on reversing the sales decline experienced in fiscal 1996 and 1995.
